title: Tricuspid valve replacement
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Annular valve
designs.summary: A generic supported valve across the representative  tricuspid junction.

designs.label: Flared annular valve
designs.summary: A representative flared support alternative at the same right AV site.

states.label: 1. Anatomy context
states.note: Representative sectioned shell and approximate junction; no native leaflet reconstruction.

states.label: 2. Replacement open
states.note: Representative open replacement leaflets; support frame fixed.

states.label: 3. Replacement closed
states.note: Representative closure pose; support frame unchanged. No flow or seal calculation.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Right chambers
views.title: See the valve between the chambers
views.lesson: The real right atrium, right ventricle and caval veins from a heart model are opened along their length. The native valve and its papillary muscles are shown first; the generic replacement then sits in the valve ring. The valve position shown is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Local approach
views.title: Approach from the right atrium
views.lesson: The arrow comes through the right atrium toward the valve. The complete route is not shown.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the tissue–device relationship
views.lesson: A generic annular replacement occupies the right AV junction rather than a caval vessel.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look along the opening
views.lesson: The face view complements the section. All poses and proportions are representative, not measured.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

junction.label: TRICUSPID VALVE
junction.body: The tricuspid valve lies between the right atrium and right ventricle. Its illustrated junction is schematic.

tissue.label: REPRESENTATIVE TISSUE
tissue.body: The smooth sectioned shell is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population. It is not a segmented myocardial or vessel wall.

frame.label: FIXED SUPPORT FRAME
frame.body: The generic lattice stays fixed when the prosthetic leaflets open and close. Mesh spacing and proportions are representative, not measured.

leaflet.label: PROSTHETIC LEAFLETS
leaflet.body: The thin leaflets shown are representative and open within the same support. Motion, flow and tissue contact are not calculated.

special.label: RIGHT AV JUNCTION
special.body: The native tricuspid site differs from caval implantation. Replacement leaflet poses do not model native TV mechanics.

region_atrium.label: RIGHT ATRIUM
region_atrium.body: The right atrium is the chamber above the valve.

region_ventricle.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_ventricle.body: The right ventricle is the chamber below the valve.

region_access.label: ATRIAL APPROACH
region_access.body: An approach through the right atrium toward the tricuspid valve. It does not show the complete route or a delivery device.

region_valve.label: NATIVE VALVE
region_valve.body: The native valve has three leaflets that hang from the valve ring. In the replacement states the leaflets of the generic valve are shown. The valve position shown is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_support.label: PAPILLARY MUSCLES
region_support.body: Papillary muscles rise from the ventricular wall, and cords fan out from their tips to the leaflet edges. Their shapes are representative.

region_device.label: GENERIC REPLACEMENT VALVE
region_device.body: The generic frame sits in the valve ring. Its shape is representative, not a specific product.
